mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) causes nephrotoxicity which can reduce renal clearance of telmisartan and increase hyperkalemia risk, while telmisartan reduces glomerular filtration rate through angiotensin II blockade, potentiating aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) and serum potassium closely during and after amikacin therapy; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; ensure adequate hydration and avoid concurrent use of other nephrotoxic agents.
